## IRenderTextParams type

Parameters for `renderText` — the single text send/edit method.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IRenderTextParams = {
    keyboard?: IInBoKb | null;
    data?: IData | null;
    AGBaseId?: string | null;
    mode?: IRenderMode;
    options?: IOptReply | IOptEdit | null;
    richOptions?: IOptReplyRich | null;
    fallbackEdit?: IOptFallbackEdit;
    chunkSize?: number | null;
    broadcast?: IBroadcastSendParams | null;
};
```
**References:** [IInBoKb](./gramstax.iinbokb.md)<!-- -->, [IData](./gramstax.idata.md)<!-- -->, [IRenderMode](./gramstax.irendermode.md)<!-- -->, [IOptReply](./gramstax.ioptreply.md)<!-- -->, [IOptEdit](./gramstax.ioptedit.md)<!-- -->, [IOptReplyRich](./gramstax.ioptreplyrich.md)<!-- -->, [IOptFallbackEdit](./gramstax.ioptfallbackedit.md)<!-- -->, [IBroadcastSendParams](./gramstax.ibroadcastsendparams.md)

## Remarks

All fields are optional. Rich-versus-plain content is decided at COMPILE time by the `<g-message>` block contents, not by these params; `richOptions` only shape the rich payload. `fallbackEdit` mirrors [IOptFallbackEdit](./gramstax.ioptfallbackedit.md) and defaults to `delete-reply`<!-- -->.
